item.title: GNU GPL / R package / how to aknowledge reuse of 3rd party code?
item.description: Hi, I am reusing code from a third party (GNU GPL) in my R package (also GNU GPL). I am planning to publish my package (github, CRAN). Where should I aknowledge the reuse? Do I mention it in the DESCRIPTION file? how? Or do I just insert in my package the unmodified source files? Thanks in advance for your advice. Kr
